purpose: Organization-level acquisition routes for the Strategy Assurance offer

officialRoute.label: Product page, community, and sponsored-development contact
officialRoute.rule: Use the official contact route; do not approach community members individually.

evidence.claim: OctoBot publicly offers strategy creation, backtesting, optimization, automated deployment across more than 12 exchanges, community access, and sponsored development.

prospects.hypothesis: Independent readiness review could complement built-in testing for advanced users or sponsored strategies.
prospects.likelyObjection: The platform already provides backtesting, paper trading, and strategy tooling.
prospects.firstAsk: Would the team evaluate one co-branded readiness-review pilot or refer one suitable advanced operator?
prospects.manualNextAction: Revalidate the contact route, then prepare one organization-level pilot note.

officialRoute.label: Official course portal
officialRoute.rule: Confirm that a current cohort or alumni program is active before contact.

evidence.claim: Botcamp describes professional training and certification for market makers and algorithmic traders using Hummingbot.

prospects.hypothesis: A capstone or alumni pre-live clinic could convert trained strategy builders into qualified reviews.
prospects.likelyObjection: The curriculum and certification may already cover strategy validation.
prospects.firstAsk: Is the current program open to an independent operate/restrict/stop clinic for one cohort or alumni group?
prospects.manualNextAction: Verify current program activity before preparing an organization-level note.

officialRoute.label: Integration Partners directory and application
officialRoute.rule: Use the formal application; do not claim partner status before acceptance.

evidence.claim: QuantConnect maintains a directory of independent consultants and firms and publicly invites partner applications.

prospects.hypothesis: A formal listing could make independent deployment assurance discoverable to algorithmic-trading organizations.
prospects.likelyObjection: Existing partners already provide strategy design and support.
prospects.firstAsk: Would an independent deployment-evidence and exchange-reconciliation service qualify for the directory?
prospects.manualNextAction: Prepare, but do not submit, a concise partner application with a redacted sample deliverable.

officialRoute.label: Official community page and public Discord
officialRoute.rule: Ask a moderator in an appropriate public channel; never direct-message members.

evidence.claim: Hummingbot describes a global community of algorithmic-trading developers and traders, names Discord as its primary hub, and explicitly warns against direct messages.

prospects.hypothesis: A moderator-approved educational clinic could surface operators with a real pre-live decision.
prospects.likelyObjection: Commercial promotion may not be welcome in a free open-source support community.
prospects.firstAsk: May an educational pre-live evidence checklist be shared in an approved public channel with no member solicitation?
prospects.manualNextAction: Read current community rules and prepare one moderator-permission request.

officialRoute.label: Official documentation and community entry
officialRoute.rule: Ask maintainers for permission before any promotional content.

evidence.claim: Jesse documents self-hosted backtesting, live trading, exchange connectivity, risk management helpers, and an official community route.

prospects.hypothesis: Exchange-reconciled economics and operating-control review could complement native strategy metrics.
prospects.likelyObjection: Jesse already provides backtesting, metrics, and risk-management helpers.
prospects.firstAsk: Would maintainers permit one educational deployment-readiness session for operators considering live trading?
prospects.manualNextAction: Review current community rules and prepare a no-pitch session outline.

officialRoute.label: White-label partner page
officialRoute.rule: Use the enterprise partnership route and position the review as independent customer acceptance.

evidence.claim: HaasOnline markets white-label automated trading to exchanges, platforms, wealth managers, and crypto projects through a formal partner route.

prospects.hypothesis: Independent acceptance review may help enterprise customers validate their own strategy and operating configuration.
prospects.likelyObjection: The platform already positions itself as enterprise-grade and compliance-ready.
prospects.firstAsk: Would the partner team evaluate independent customer-deployment assurance as an optional implementation add-on?
prospects.manualNextAction: Prepare a narrow complement-versus-overlap comparison before any contact.

officialRoute.label: Official documentation and Discord support route
officialRoute.rule: Ask maintainers first; never solicit members or request exchange keys.

evidence.claim: Freqtrade documents dry-run and live trading, backtesting, optimization, exchange support, and its official Discord community.

prospects.hypothesis: A neutral evidence checklist could identify operators moving from dry-run to capital at risk.
prospects.likelyObjection: Paid promotion is unlikely to belong in a volunteer support channel.
prospects.firstAsk: May a neutral pre-live evidence checklist be shared once in an approved channel with no direct solicitation?
prospects.manualNextAction: Read current rules and prepare one moderator-permission request.

officialRoute.label: Official community resources
officialRoute.rule: Treat as a community channel; contract only with an identifiable operator.

evidence.claim: Superalgos exposes official community routes for users of its open-source strategy design, testing, and deployment platform.
Superalgos documentation says the project is governed by a decentralized contributor community rather than a legal entity.

prospects.hypothesis: A moderator-approved clinic may reach decentralized trading teams that can contract individually.
prospects.likelyObjection: There may be no central buyer or organization able to approve a commercial partnership.
prospects.firstAsk: Would moderators welcome a no-pitch operational-readiness clinic for community operators?
prospects.manualNextAction: Verify current community governance and rules before preparing a permission request.

officialRoute.label: Market-making product and organization contact
officialRoute.rule: Approach only for a clearly independent, non-competing second-line review.

evidence.claim: Enflux publicly describes 24/7 algorithmic market making, risk controls, execution telemetry, and audit-grade traceability.

prospects.hypothesis: A narrow external second-line review could help only when independence is explicitly required.
prospects.likelyObjection: Its in-house transparency, audit, and analytics positioning overlaps materially with Strategy Assurance.
prospects.firstAsk: Is there a defined need for independent second-line validation that does not duplicate the firm's own analytics?
prospects.manualNextAction: Keep on the watchlist unless an explicit independence trigger appears.
